description: Local trigger and behavior evals for the agent-maintenance skill.

trigger_cases.prompt: Remember this: always run pre_submit before pushing, and don't put long runbooks in AGENTS.md.
Refresh agent brain and audit all rules and skills for drift.
Score our ITGPT checkpoint on the validation split and print the scoreboard.

behavior_cases.prompt: User says: 'Remember this: always check eval_val_breakdown.json before picking the next architecture tweak.' Explain the exact steps to promote this steering correction.
rubric: Follows TDD hill-climbing: adds or tightens a failing local eval case under the target skill directory first, promotes to the smallest durable layer (not AGENTS.md prose), verifies FAIL -> PASS without regressions, and prepends a JRN receipt.
